Frontend Paper Trading renders correctly with RESET ACCOUNT button present (not clicked), account $100.29M, 16 positions, 150 orders preserved.

The rate_limit() helper is proven functionally correct via /api/wellington/analyze-url (429 hit within 11 rapid calls at limit=10/60s). Same helper same code path, so chat bucket is code-equivalent. critical_code_review_comments: SSRF validator validate_public_url() at server.py:81 correctly blocks non http/https, unresolvable hosts, and private/loopback/link-local/reserved/multicast/unspecified IPs. Uses socket.getaddrinfo which resolves DNS and inspects all returned addresses — good defence against DNS-rebinding-style bypasses at request time. requests.get uses allow_redirects=False and streams with a MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES+1 read cap — also correct.

Rate limiter is per-process in-memory (server.py:68). Since supervisor runs uvicorn with --workers 1, this is fine for now, but if workers scale >1 the bucket will fragment. Consider Redis-backed limiter or slowapi if horizontal scale becomes a requirement.

Rate limit key uses first entry of x-forwarded-for (server.py:72). In this k8s environment the ingress presents at least 2 pod IPs (10.231.142.130 and 10.231.142.133 seen in backend log) which means a single upstream client can be split across buckets. Not a security issue (still caps aggregate load) but worth noting.

ResetAccountRequest (server.py:1312) correctly requires confirm=='RESET-ACCOUNT' before wiping. Empty body and wrong string both return 400 and do not touch the DB — verified by comparing order_history length before/after.

Error handlers on upload-image / analyze-url / upload-file / chat all catch generic Exception and return a canned 'Failed to …' / 'Wellington AI request failed' message rather than str(e) — good. HTTPException is re-raised, preserving 400/413/429 status codes.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY fail-closed at server.py:41-42 (raises RuntimeError if missing) — hardcoded fallback removed. Backend booted cleanly on this iteration, confirming env-wired.
App.js is still ~4085 lines (from prior iteration comment) — recommend modularization when time permits.
